pages.title: Welcome to Netplay
pages.description: Host on one device, then choose Join on the other. Both devices should have the same game. Press A to continue.

pages.title: Compatibility cores
pages.description: Use Netplay's matched cores when the installed cores differ between devices?

pages.title: Ready to play
pages.description: Choose Host or Join in the main menu. You can change this answer later in Configuration > Settings. Press A to finish.
